mapper.sql: id, email, password_hash, nickname, user_level, gender, address_sido, address_sigungu, latitude, longitude, login_fail_count, is_locked, locked_at, use_yn, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM users WHERE email = #{email} AND use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT email, nickname FROM ( SELECT email, nickname FROM users WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND (email = #{email} OR nickname = #{nickname}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN email = #{email} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET login_fail_count = login_fail_count + 1, updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET login_fail_count = 0, updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET is_locked = 1, locked_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP), updated_at = SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{id}
